Changelog

0.1.0-planning — prepared 2026-10-24

Initial source-catalog and documentation package. Contains four dataset cards, eleven published upstream URLs, source bibliographies, a conceptual graph specification, an illustrative viewer, a README-driven website, and repository consistency checks.

This entry records package preparation, not a GitHub release, an award, a source-file audit, or completion of proposed MANIFOLD research.

MANIFOLD / 0.1.0-PLANNING

Existing data: Future Factories, University of South Carolina. Proposed enhancement consortium led by The University of Alabama. Illustrations are not verified source records. No NSF award or endorsement is claimed.
